title: Kissed Velvety Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A romantic Algerian dish featuring tender lamb in a rich and aromatic sauce, perfect for a special occasion. This recipe is high in protein and cooked to perfection in a copper pot.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a copper pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground lamb and cook until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the ground cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped dried apricots and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Traditionally, the tagine is cooked over low heat for a long period of time, which allows the flavors to meld together and the meat to become tender.
